Wrong basis: GRT-estimated RC, not the signed (routed RCX) view required by METHODOLOGY 9.7.
findings.rc_non_uniform: estimate minus RCX clock arrival per sink: TT +11.6..+45.2 ps (mean 25.3), FF +8.5..+37.3: smallest on the W-face column (~13), largest on the SE corner (35-45). Clock skew therefore moves after route.

ff_hold_107_after_rebind (162 before).macro_wd_in_63: all g_bank[0].u_m/wd_in right-edge bits <- g_mw[0].u_d/q regs (SE cluster). Capture (macro clk, separate 7-delaybuf branch from the W trunk) 282.9 ps vs launch leaves 262-265 ps: +18-20 ps capture-late on a 58 ps clk->Q+INV path. Estimated skew on the same pairs 1.4 ps -> RCX 12.2 ps mean: the GRT-stage hold repair (+1.05 ps on GRT RC) was invalidated by the RC basis.
ff_hold_107_after_rebind (162 before).pinreg_to_stage2_44: zero-logic shifts pw16_data->l_w16d (S face), pvm_wdata->l_sud, pa_addr->s1_off (W face), 3-26 um apart, launch/capture on different leaves (capture +2..+26 ps).

findings.drv: 15 TT / 9 FF slew > 320 ps: place2005-2008/2036/2038/2050 long nets with weak drivers (structural: same RC basis + long SE<->W spans)

proposed_structural_fix: F1 basis (9.7): vclk source latency, sdc_lint insertion_ps and CORE_LATENCY bound to the routed RCX TT pin-register mean 359.64 (FF 287.20, early tap 109.64); flow rule: route -> RCX -> measure I -> rebind -> signoff; I is never taken from a GRT estimate. Applied in the successor copy (STA-only check: clock contract PASS, FF -12.71/107, TT +169.72).

F2 RC correlation: fit set_wire_rc clock/signal scale (M2-M5) on this routed DB so per-sink estimate-RCX clock arrival error <= +-3 ps (now +11.6..+45.2); use the fitted RC for CTS, clock_leaf_balance and the GRT-stage hold/DRV repair.

F3 macro-interface clock structure: per SRAM one skew group = macro clk pin + its wd_in/w_mask/addr launch registers + rd_out capture registers, one sub-tree rooted at a buffer at the macro's left-bottom clk pin; the right-edge write-data register cluster is tapped from that sub-tree root (not from a separate SE leaf), balanced <= 10 ps to the macro clk pin.

F4 pin-register successor pairs: CTS sink clustering keeps each zero-logic pin-reg -> stage-2 pair on the same leaf (S-face w16/vm_wdata, W-face pa_addr); residual hold repaired at CTS/GRT stage on the correlated RC with margin 10.
Re-run: from 3_place.odb (placement/pins/RTL unchanged) re-CTS with F2-F4, GRT, route, RCX, F1 rebind, signoff. Not an ECO.
